Tell Two Friends

HS Algebra II · Podcast Interview · African & African Diaspora Voices · Deck A · SSF-HS11-L2-13001400-HSALG2-PCI-AAD
THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The radio goal

As you record, the four facts fill in. Write one equation, then solve for the weeks.

THE SCENE

You host the school podcast. Today you are recording an interview in the library. A city radio station will play your show when enough people listen. The show is on a short break. When the break ends, you must say how many weeks that will take. Four people each know one fact you need.

THE HISTORY

This show is about a newspaper called the Chicago Defender. Robert Abbott started it in Chicago in 1905. Train workers carried it to cities all over the country. Each newspaper was shared with many readers.
